Market today: The market's mood is cautious, driven by Fed Chairman Warsh's comments. He held back on clear rate signals but praised global tightening, suggesting rates might stay higher for longer. This creates a "wait-and-see" environment, which can be tough on growth-oriented tech and chip names.

Your holdings: You've got several leveraged positions like SOXL (-52.24%), MUU (-26.06%), and SPAL (-35.19%) deep in the red, and their stops are already blown. SMCI (-20.03%) is also a concern with its stop breached. Remember, margin amplifies these drops, especially with leveraged ETFs that decay over time.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further Fed commentary for clearer rate signals. Also, monitor your existing leveraged positions for any signs of further deterioration.

Bottom line: Focus on risk management and protecting capital in your most vulnerable, leveraged positions.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is long gone; consider exiting this -52.24% leveraged position to prevent further decay and capital erosion.
MUU & SPAL: Similar to SOXL, these leveraged ETFs are significantly down (-26.06%, -35.19%) with breached stops. Evaluate if holding these positions makes sense given the decay and margin risk.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The Fed's "wait-and-see" stance doesn't provide a strong catalyst for new tech entries right now.
